intent: File a new service-desk ticket with its summary, description, type, priority and component.
second_installation: a new custom field 'Site' (a select, default HQ) added to the ticket form (trac.ini [ticket-custom])

verify_yaml.first:
schema_version: openadapt.verify/v1
app:
  name: Trac service desk (local test copy)
  url: http://127.0.0.1:9485/newticket
  version: trac@1.6
  session: benchmark.onboarding_effort.hooks:open_session
  reset:
    python: benchmark.onboarding_effort.hooks:reset
verifier:
  kind: sql
  sqlite_database: /Users/abrichr/oa/scratch/onboarding-effort/trac-db/trac.db
  sql_query: "SELECT id, summary, description, type, priority, component, reporter FROM ticket"
record:
  name: ticket
  match: [summary]
  duplicate_key: summary
  fields:
    summary: summary
    description: description
    type: type
    priority: priority
    component: component
save_step: auto
inputs:
  source: recorded
  unique: [summary]
campaign:
  id: onboarding-tr-ticket-new-first
  trials: 3
  policy: permissive
